title: First-order decay and half-life
summary: Change the observed rate constant and say how the decaying absorbance moves, where the half-life lands, and how long it is in seconds.

spec.formula: Abs = Abs0 e^(-kobs t), and the half-life is the time at which Abs = Abs0 / 2
spec.why: The half-life is the time for the absorbance to fall to half its starting value, and for a first-order reaction it is ln 2 divided by kobs, so with kobs at {kobs} it is {half} (it was {half0}).
spec.note: Assumes absorbance is proportional to concentration, so Abs/Abs0 stands in for [A]/[A]0.
